rows.label: tlk70000070_05_msg0001
rows.name:
I never thought one of you guys—no,
one of you—would be appointed the new
Knight-sama...

rows.label: tlk70000070_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Seems I had some incredible people
helping me with my hunting...

rows.label: tlk70000070_05_msg0003
rows.name:
But if you're heading to the Divine
Beast's core, this isn't the way.

rows.label: tlk70000070_05_msg0004
rows.name:
From Orunato Mountain Path, pass
through Braying Canyon and
reach Dana Desert first.

rows.label: tlk70000070_05_msg0005
rows.name:
Once you see Lake Alegria, head for
the great staircase along the woodland
path.

rows.label: tlk70000070_05_msg0006
rows.name:
I may be poor, but years of
hunting have given me a good lay
of the land around here! Eheh.

rows.label: tlk70000070_05_msg0007
rows.name:
But you're different from someone like
me. You must have greater power, and a
greater mission.

rows.label: tlk70000070_05_msg0008
rows.name:
So please! Defeat Heaven's Holy Grail
and save this country!

rows.label: tlk70000070_05_msg0009
rows.name:
And please... leave a future for my
son!
